description: Dept. of Local Government - Northern Province Fill the Vacant of Chairman of Vengalacheddikulam Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically concerns the election process for a local government position (Chairman of Vengalacheddikulam Pradeshiya Sabha). It announces the convening of a meeting to fill a vacant elected position under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, which falls under electoral processes and related matters. This matches the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for election announcements and schedules.
